incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Royal Legislative Decree 1/2010 of 2 July approving the consolidated text of the Capital Companies Act (Ley de Sociedades de Capital, LSC), in particular Articles 21 (minimum capital), 22 (payment of capital), 30 (incorporation formalities), 33 (public deed), 62 (registered office), 176 and 209 (governance and board powers); Royal Decree 1784/1996 approving the Commercial Registry Regulations; Royal Decree 421/2007 on central registry name certification; Law 14/2013 on the Sociedad Limitada de Formación Sucesiva.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Central for negative name certification; Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province where the registered office is situated for registration of the company; the public deed is authorized by a Notary (Notario) in the same locality.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public deed of incorporation (Escritura Pública de Constitución) executed before a Spanish notary and subsequently registered in the Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil), following prior issuance of a negative name certificate (certificación negativa de denominación).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The statutory minimum capital for a Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada is EUR 3,000, fully subscribed and paid at incorporation (Article 21 LSC). Cash contributions must be lodged with a Spanish credit institution in an escrow/blocked account opened in the company's name; the bank certificate must be presented to the notary, or the notary may receive the funds for immediate deposit. The capital cannot be withdrawn until registration is complete. A company may incorporate with capital below EUR 3,000 only under the Sociedad de Formación Sucesiva regime, subject to the restrictive conditions of Article 4 bis LSC. For a tunnelling-machinery spare-part manufacturer, a paid-up capital of at least EUR 50,000 is commercially and contractually advisable to support tender guarantees and ISO certifications.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The Board unanimously resolved: (1) to approve the subscription and payment of the share capital evidenced by the incorporation deed and bank certificate, each contribution complying with Article 21 of the Capital Companies Act; (2) to fix the registered office at [address], Spain; and (3) to appoint [Name] as Managing Director/CEO, [Name] as Chief Financial Officer, and [Name] as Company Secretary, with authority to execute banking, tax, labor, industrial, environmental, and municipal filings. The Board further confirmed that the corporate bylaws have been adopted in full and instructed the officers to obtain the definitive tax number, register the deed, and file all ancillary permits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain negative name certificate (Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central, Madrid – submission made electronically through the Colegio de Registradores online portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the standard application (Solicitud de Certificación Negativa de Denominación) indicating at least three proposed corporate names in order of priority. The registry verifies whether each proposed name coincides or is confusingly similar with an existing company name or protected trade name. Upon favorable verification, a negative name certificate is issued, which is valid for three months from its date and cannot be renewed. The certificate must be presented to the notary before executing the incorporation deed.
required_dossiers: Completed application form for negative name certification
Three proposed corporate denominations in priority order
Proof of payment of the official certification tariff
Incorporator identification documents (D.N.I., N.I.E., or passport)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the first proposed name is rejected, the Central Registry automatically considers the following alternatives; if all proposed names are rejected, the applicant may submit a new application with different names. An objecting party may file administrative or judicial opposition, but the applicant may proceed if no blocking name is identified. The application may be expedited through urgent service, and a new certificate must be obtained if the three-month validity expires.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execute the public deed of incorporation before a Spanish notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notario (Spanish public notary) of the locality where the registered office is located.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: All incorporators must appear before the notary, personally or through validly authorized representatives, and declare their will to incorporate a limited liability company. The notary reviews the legality of the draft articles of association, confirms that the minimum capital has been subscribed and fully paid, and verifies the identity, legal capacity, and non-disqualification of the founding shareholders and directors. The deed is signed by the incorporators, directors accepting office, and the notary, who issues the matrix copy and certified first copies for filing and tax purposes.
required_dossiers: Negative name certificate issued by the Registro Mercantil Central
Draft articles of association (estatutos sociales)
Bank deposit certificate of the subscribed capital in a Spanish credit institution, or notary receipt of funds
Statements of acceptance of office signed by each appointed director
Valid identity documents (D.N.I., N.I.E., or passport) of all incorporators and directors
Document evidencing the legal representative capacity if acting on behalf of any shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary refuses to authorize the deed due to defective clauses or missing documents, the incorporators must correct the draft and promptly reschedule execution. If the name certificate has expired, a new certificate must be obtained before execution. If the capital deposit certificate is incomplete, the notary cannot proceed until the funds are fully lodged in escrow. Any defect in representation documents can be cured by re-execution or ratification before the same notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Apply for the provisional Tax Identification Number (NIF provisional)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) – competent State Tax Agency office corresponding to the company's tax domicile.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within one month after execution of the public deed and before or while registration is pending, submit the census declaration using Model 036 and the NIF application. Attach the first copy of the public deed and identify the legal representative. AEAT issues a provisional NIF with the character 'C' that permits the company to open bank accounts, enter into contracts, and obtain its definitive NIF once registration in the Mercantile Registry is completed.
required_dossiers: First copy of the public deed of incorporation
Completed census declaration (Modelo 036)
Identification document of the legal representative (D.N.I./N.I.E./passport)
Appointment document of the legal representative, if already adopted
Form or authorization evidencing the representative's fiscal address in Spain
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, AEAT will notify the defect and the applicant must complement the declaration on Model 036 or attach the missing deed copy. If the provisional NIF is not issued because the deed has not yet been registered, the company can continue using the provisional number for pre-registration acts; no banking or contracting can be legally completed without a valid NIF, so corrections should be made expeditiously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the incorporation deed in the Provincial Mercantile Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the first copy of the notarial deed to the competent Provincial Mercantile Registry within one month of execution. The registrar examines the legal capacity of the incorporators, the agreement of the partners, the minimum capital requirements, the legality of the bylaws, and the registered office. If the qualification is favorable, the company is entered in the Registry and the deed is archived. Registration is public and produces legal personality for the company.
required_dossiers: First copy of the public deed of incorporation
Provisional NIF certificate or census registration document
Bank certificate of capital deposit where not integrated in the deed
Statements of acceptance of office for directors
Proof of payment of the registration tariff
Power of attorney if application is filed by a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a note of defects (nota de calificación), the company or notary must remedy the observations by presenting supplementary documents, modifying the deed by resolution, or amending the bylaws before the same registry. If the registry refuses registration, the company may file an administrative appeal (recurso de alzada) with the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública within two months. An incorrect registered domain can also be corrected through a rectification deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain definitive NIF, register as employer with Social Security, and open the company's operational tax files
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS); municipal taxes office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the Mercantile Registry entry is completed, apply at AEAT for conversion of the provisional NIF into the definitive NIF and file the updated Model 036. Simultaneously register the company as an employer with TGSS using Sistema RED, obtain the employer contribution account code (código de cuenta de cotización), and register the company for VAT, corporate income tax, and any required withholdings. For a manufacturing entity the company must also file the commencement-of-operations declaration and obtain the relevant electronic certificates for e-filing.
required_dossiers: Certificate of registration in the Mercantile Registry (certificación de inscripción)
Provisional NIF certificate
Updated Model 036 census declaration
N.I.E./D.N.I. of the managing director
Social Security employer registration form (TA.7) and SIG/Sistema RED activation
Lease deed, ownership title, or right of use of the registered office and production premises
C.N.A.E. code correspondence (2824 for the manufacture of tunnelling machinery)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT detects a mismatch between the registry address and the tax domicile, the client must correct the census via Model 036 and align the registered office. If TGSS rejects employer registration due to an incorrect activity code, the code must be revised to ISIC 2824/NAICS 333120. Missing electronic certificates can be reactivated via accreditation with the Tax Agency, and late filing penalties may be waived if the correction is made before inspection.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legalize corporate books and open governance records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial; official electronic book legalization platform approved by the Dirección General.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After registration, the company must create and keep the mandatory corporate books: book of minutes (libro de actas), register of partners (libro registro de socios), and register of contracts with the sole shareholder or related governing contracts if applicable. These books must be submitted annually to the Provincial Mercantile Registry for electronic legalization (encuadernación) before the end of the following April. Corporate governance documents, notices, and board decisions must be recorded chronologically and signed by the Secretary.
required_dossiers: Digital files of the corporate books in the registry-approved electronic format
Excel or XML templates with pagination required by the registry
Power of attorney for electronic submission
Receipt of prior legalization or registry inscription of the company
Verified minutes of the first board meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the electronic legalization is rejected due to format defects, the registry communicates the anomaly and the company must resubmit corrected files. If the books are submitted late, the company may be liable for a formal warning or financial penalty under the Commercial Registry Regulations; the correction must be made as soon as possible and a justified delay request may be filed to mitigate the fine.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Industry, Energy and Mines of the corresponding Autonomous Community (Consejería de Industria, Energía y Minas), together with the municipal council (Ayuntamiento) acting through its Urbanism, Environment and Activity Licensing offices. Coordination with the Ministry for the Ecological Transition and the Demographic Challenge (MITECO) is required where cross-border envionmental impacts occur.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Licencia de actividad clasificada / apertura y funcionamiento (Municipal activity and opening license) and, where the installed capacity or emission thresholds are exceeded, Autorización Ambiental Integrada (Integrated Environmental Authorization) or Autorización Ambiental Unificada (Unified Environmental Authorization) under regional environmental legislation.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Consejería de Medio Ambiente e Transición Ecológica of the Autonomous Community; for projects requiring state-level assessment, the Dirección General de Calidad y Evaluación Ambiental (MITECO).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Manufacture of tunnelling machine spare parts under ISIC 2824/NAICS 333120 typically falls in Category B – Simplified Environmental Impact Assessment (Evaluación Ambiental Simplificada) under Annex II of Law 21/2013 on environmental assessment, unless the facility comprises foundry, paint-coating lines, or waste-processing installations that exceed the numerical thresholds, in which case the project must undergo a Category A – Ordinary Environmental Impact Assessment (Evaluación Ambiental Ordinaria).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Royal Decree 815/2013 and Directive 2010/75/EU as amended by Directive (EU) 2024/1785 regarding industrial emission limit values for particulate matter, NOx, SO2, CO, organic solvents, and volatile organic compounds (VOCs); Royal Decree 117/2003 for solvent emission limits in surface-coating activities; Royal Decree 102/2011 on ambient air quality; Law 7/2022 on waste and contaminated soils for hazardous waste duty-of-care, waste transfer notes, producer registration, and storage requirements; and municipal/regional sewerage bylaws governing wastewater discharge parameters, including pH, suspended solids, heavy metals, oils, and EC/COD thresholds, prior to any discharge into public sewage networks.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification (certificado de seguridad contra incendios) issued by the local fire service and a technical architect, pursuant to Royal Decree 2267/2004 on fire-safety installations in industrial establishments; structural load inspection and foundation certificate for heavy machinery foundations and overhead crane tracks; municipal building/first-occupancy license for the industrial premises; occupational health and safety clearance through a workers' prevention plan (Plan de Prevención de Riesgos Laborales) and a pre-commencement workplace visit report issued by the labour authority (Inspección de Trabajo y Seguridad Social); and, if required, a major-accident-hazards evaluation under Royal Decree 840/2015 for facilities storing dangerous substances.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), official portal at https://www.agenciatributaria.gob.es/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must obtain a NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal) by submitting an application to the AEAT, including passport or foreign identification, company incorporation certificate (translated into Spanish), proof of address, and tax representative authorization if required. Online submission via AEAT electronic headquarters is available for eligible non-residents.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available. Hybrid mismatch rules apply under the EU Anti-Tax Avoidance Directive; tax group consolidation permitted for qualifying Spanish corporate groups.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Facturae electronic invoicing system requiring certified digital software to generate and transmit invoices to the AEAT in real-time for validation, digital stamping, and clearance, with API integrations for large taxpayers.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to exports of goods outside the European Union upon submission of proof that the goods have left EU territory. Offshore services qualify for zero-rating if supplied to a non-EU customer and not consumed in Spain.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate or proof of payment to non-EU recipient
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims result in penalties up to 100% of evaded VAT plus interest and potential criminal liability; retrospective clawback applies if export documentation is insufficient upon audit.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain) is the central monetary and banking authority responsible for balance-of-payments statistical reporting and AML/CFT supervision; the Secretaría de Estado de Comercio (Ministry of Economy, Trade and Business) and the Dirección General de Comercio Internacional e Inversiones administer the Spanish Registry of Foreign Investments, foreign investment screening under Act 8/2020, and export/trade policy controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain is a full-convertibility regime. As an EU Member State applying Articles 63-66 TFEU, there are no exchange controls, no capital-flow gates, and no mandatory conversion of foreign currencies into EUR. Current-account payments (trade, services, royalties, dividends) and capital-account operations (equity injections, shareholder loans, disposals) are freely permitted for residents and non-residents. Profit remittance is unrestricted at the FX layer; the only legal hurdles are the statutory 19% dividend withholding for non-resident shareholders, which may be reduced to 0%-5% under Directive 2011/96/EU or an applicable double-tax treaty, and statistical/declarative obligations: the resident SL must file the Banco de España D-series external-transaction declarations under Circular 4/2012 for flows above the applicable EUR 50,000 per-transaction / EUR 150,000 quarterly aggregation thresholds, and every non-resident direct investment in the SL exceeding EUR 3,000 must be reported to the Registry of Foreign Investments within one month after completion. Investments in ISIC 2824 TBM spare-part manufacturing are outside the strategic-sector prior-approval perimeter of Act 8/2020 (defence, dual-use and critical technologies, critical infrastructure, energy, data, media), so no ex-ante screening is expected for a standard manufacturing SL.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Spain abolished all export-proceeds surrender and conversion obligations during the 1980s/1990s liberalisation (culminating in Royal Decree-Law 664/1999 and Royal Decree 69/2002). Spanish exporters may retain 100% of export receipts, in EUR or any foreign currency, in domestic, EU/EEA, or third-country bank accounts for an unlimited period, with no statutory surrender timeline and no mandatory conversion ratio. The only compliance overlay is statistical: export flows are captured through Spanish customs (DUA), while financial flows with non-residents above the Banco de España Circular 4/2012 thresholds remain subject to D-1/D-2 form filing; there is no clawback, forced sale, or FX conversion obligation for ISIC 2824 spare-part exporters.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: From 1 February to 31 March of the year following the reporting fiscal year where related-party transactions exceed EUR 100,000 or operations with tax havens exist.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty for omission or incorrect data up to 0.1% of the net amount of the omitted transactions with a minimum of EUR 100; inaccuracies may also attract fixed fines; no direct administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year SL, from 1 July to 25 July inclusive in the year following the tax period; within 25 days and 6 months after fiscal year-end.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge (5% to 20% progressive) plus late-payment interest of 5.00% per annum; fixed penalty up to EUR 1,500; persistent non-payment can trigger tax enforcement but does not cause administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholder approval no later than 30 June for calendar-year SL; deposit with the Commercial Registry no later than one month after approval, normally 31 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late deposit fines from EUR 1,200 up to EUR 60,000; the Commercial Registry closes the entity's register sheet after three consecutive years of non-deposit, blocking new filings and potentially leading to administrative strike-off for inactive companies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: UBO Annual Confirmation / Beneficial Owner Declaration (Titularidad Real)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial (with annual accounts) and AML supervisory authorities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Accompanying the deposit of annual accounts, no later than the final date for annual accounts filing (31 July for calendar-year SL); updated separately within 10 days of any relevant ownership change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monetary penalties under Spanish AML Law 10/2010 ranging from EUR 600 to EUR 600,000; the Registry may suspend filings; no direct strike-off action is triggered by the UBO declaration alone.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for an SL when at least two of the following criteria are met for two consecutive financial years: total assets exceed EUR 4,000,000; annual net turnover exceeds EUR 8,000,000; average number of employees exceeds 50. Audit is also required for parent companies obligated to prepare consolidated accounts or when the audit is ordered by a court or the Commercial Registry.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP (Plan General Contable, R.D. 1514/2007), including the SME PGC under R.D. 1515/2007 for small entities; IFRS/EU is mandatory for consolidated groups unless the small-group exemption applies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SL must maintain a continuous internal register of ultimate beneficial owners under Law 10/2010. Annual confirmation is fulfilled as an annex to the deposit of annual accounts; the administrator must declare the identity and ownership percentage of all ultimate beneficial owners and update the registry within 10 days of any transfer that changes beneficial ownership.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book
